h1: Terms of Use for the Academy Vision Website
kicker: The Ground Rules, in Plain Language
lede: This is the website of Academy Vision, the eye care practice at 90 Atlantic City Blvd in Pine Beach, NJ. These terms explain how you may use it. By browsing the site or sending us information through it, you agree to them; if you don’t agree, please don’t use the site.

sections.heading: What These Terms Cover
sections.html:
These terms apply to every page of this website, including its forms and the links that lead to other services. They work alongside our privacy policy, which describes how health information may be used and shared, and our disclaimer about the health information on this site.

What you read here is general and educational. It isn’t a diagnosis or a substitute for an eye exam, and using the site doesn’t make you a patient of the practice.

sections.heading: Using the Site Respectfully
sections.html:
You’re welcome to browse, read and share links to our pages. When you use the site, please don’t:

  • enter information that isn’t true, or someone else’s details without their permission;
  • try to reach parts of the site, its systems or its data that aren’t open to the public;
  • send or upload anything harmful, such as viruses or code meant to disrupt the site;
  • copy the site in bulk with automated tools, or use it for anything unlawful.

sections.heading: Appointment Requests and Urgent Problems
sections.html:
The Book Appointment button opens an outside scheduling service in a new tab, and our appointment request form lets you tell us the dates and times that suit you. A request sent through that form isn’t a booked visit until our office has been in touch and you’ve agreed on a time.

Please don’t use online forms for anything urgent. If you have an eye problem that needs attention soon, call us at (732) 978-9306. For sudden vision loss, a chemical splash, an object that has penetrated the eye, a curtain or shadow over your vision, or flashes with a sudden shower of new floaters, seek emergency care immediately or call 911.

sections.heading: Who Owns the Content
sections.html: The words, photos, graphics and logo on this website belong to Academy Vision or appear here with their owners’ permission. Frame and lens brand names and logos belong to their makers. You may view, print or save pages for your own personal, non-commercial use, but please don’t copy, change, republish or sell any part of the site without our written permission.

sections.heading: Links to Other Websites
sections.html: Some links take you to websites we don’t run, such as the online scheduler and map directions. We include them for your convenience. We aren’t responsible for their content, availability or privacy practices, and a link isn’t an endorsement. Those sites have their own terms, so it’s worth reading them before you share personal information.

sections.heading: The Website Is Provided As Is
sections.html: We try to keep the site correct, up to date and online, but it comes “as is” and “as available.” Where the law permits, we make no promises, express or implied, that the site will always run without errors or interruptions, that it’s free of harmful code, or that its information is complete or right for your situation. Questions about your own eyes belong at an eye exam.

sections.heading: Limits on Liability
sections.html: As far as the law permits, Academy Vision and the people who work with it aren’t liable for any loss or damage linked to using this website, to not being able to reach it, or to relying on its general information. None of this takes away a right that the law says can’t be limited.

sections.heading: When the Terms Change
sections.html: Academy Vision may revise these terms now and then, for instance when the site or the law changes. The current version is always the one on this page and applies as soon as it’s posted. If you keep using the site after an update, you accept the revised terms.

sections.heading: Reaching Us About This Page
sections.html: Want to ask about anything on this page? Call Academy Vision at (732) 978-9306 or write to us at 90 Atlantic City Blvd, Pine Beach, NJ 08741. Our hours and directions are on our Pine Beach location page.

cta.heading: Talk to a Real Person
cta.html: Legal pages can feel confusing, but they don’t have to be. If anything here is unclear, call our Pine Beach office at (732) 978-9306 and we’ll go through it with you.
